messages:
Maria: Heads-up — HavenWell private slice switchover proposal.
Maria: Target window: Thu Jul 17 02:30-03:30 UTC. requesting ops + eng signoff for the slot and rollback gates.
Maria: Why: migrate tenant to Private Dedicated capacity and apply serving runtime pin to avoid kv-cache invalidation after the model refresh.
Samir: I will check KMS rotation collision. There's a rotation in eu-west-1 at 02:00-02:15 but looks scoped to infra keys, not tenant keys. Will confirm by EOD.
Kevin: We need explicit pin details. Proposed: serving_runtime=v2.3.1-rc2, model_hash=sha256:ab12cdef34b67890cafe. If anyone sees mismatch call rollback immediately.
Julie (ops): Dry-run plan: 1) reserve slice s-haven-42, 2) drain traffic (10m), 3) infra switch-slice, 4) smoke tests. I'll run dry-run at 01:45 UTC and post logs.
Julie (ops): Dry-run command I'll use:
```
infra switch-slice --tenant=havenwell --slice=s-42 --to=private-v2.3.1 --dry-run
```
Ryan T: +1 on the later 02:30 start to avoid any KMS overlap — I can be oncall for the window.
DeployBot: DeployBot: canary started on s-haven-42 (canary id c-775) — metrics snapshot: 200r/s, errors 0.2%, p95=98ms — status: PASS.
Maria: Final rollback criteria (agreed): sustained error rate >3% over 5m, OR p95 latency +200ms vs baseline for 10m, OR smoke tests fail on >=2 endpoints.
Maria: Rollback manual command if triggered:
```
infra switch-slice --tenant=havenwell --slice=s-42 --to=hosted-stable
```
Samir: KMS update: confirmed tenant key unaffected. safe to proceed at 02:30.
Kevin: Pin + model hash verified. I'm good with the window. :thumbsup:
Julie (ops): Dry-run completed, logs clean — no permission or routing errors. Scheduling real run for 02:30 UTC. I'll coordinate with deploybot.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: PagerDuty rota updated — Ryan T assigned for 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Ryan T: I'll monitor metrics and post live status updates in this thread during roll. standing by.
Maria: Thanks everyone — moving to scheduled. I'll update internal release notes and send the customer-facing window now. :rocket:
Maria: Post-roll checklist: verify trace sampling, verify cost telemetry, confirm no 5xx regressions in 30m after switch.
Kevin: noted. good luck.
Julie (ops): ready on my side.
Ryan T: ready.
Maria: closing thread for scheduling — will reopen if any blocker appears. :white_check_mark:
